recipe_rationale: Different budgets for torso, motor hip covers, long thigh, lower leg/foot and each arm segment.
Allocate every connected CAD region by surface area and extent, with a minimum region floor; no minimum-area component deletion.
Repair defective large CAD skins locally at 1.5mm voxel size before bounded semantic collapse; Go2 front slotted covers use 0.7mm. Thin sensor plates are excluded.
Closed source/repaired skins receive explicit triangles and direct local collapse; planar dissolve is excluded because it broke thin closed skin topology.
The low-tier 1500 URI is a nominal target only; joint connections and clean major shells take priority over the revoked hard cap.
Low ARX link2/link3 reference the exact middle DAE resources to preserve round end axes; these meshes are shared, not duplicated under the low folder.

B2 hip/thigh covers and each ARX segment combine overlapping adjacent skins only within the same original visual link before voxel reconstruction and semantic collapse; actual joint transforms and macro voids remain acceptance requirements.
